meta-description: White or cloudy spots on hardwood are moisture trapped in the finish — usually fixable. How to read the mark, what causes it, and what repair costs in Edmonds.
post-summary: December 18, 2026 · White marks mean moisture stopped in the finish; gray or black means it reached the wood. The causes (steam mops lead the league), the wax-finish wrinkle in Edmonds' pre-war homes, and the fix ladder from a dry-out period to a $1.99/sq ft screen & recoat.
